12.sentence: We introduce AuraGenome, a large language model (LLM)-powered framework for rapid, reusable, and scalable generation of multilayered circular genome visualizations.

13.sentence: AuraGenome combines a semantic-driven multiagent workflow with an interactive visual analytics system.

14.sentence: The workflow employs seven specialized LLM-driven agents, each assigned distinct roles, such as intent recognition, layout planning, and code generation, to transform raw genomic data into tailored visualizations.

15.sentence: The system supports multiple coordinated views tailored for genomic data, offering ring, radial, and chord-based layouts to represent multilayered circular genome visualizations.

16.sentence: The system enables interactions and configuration reuse.

17.sentence: The system supports realtime refinement and high-quality report export.

1962.sentence: The overlayed alignment merges encodings into a single track.
